cohort: The study enrolled 194 term neonates, including 97 with Fetal Growth Restriction (FGR) and 97 who were appropriate-for-gestational-age (AGA).
finding: Term FGR neonates exhibited early cerebral structural and hemodynamic alterations, including a higher prevalence of subependymal cysts, significant reductions in cerebellar vermis size and TCD, and altered cerebral perfusion indicated by reduced EDV and elevated RI.
mod_finding: FGR neonates had higher cesarean delivery rates.
cross-section timing: Within the first week of life
birth_weight: FGR neonates had lower birth weights.
